args.body:
- Apparel return rates reached 24% in 2026, making returns a major cost driver for retailers.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth (~20%), showing that centralizing returns processing yields significant savings.
- Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin, so speed-to-resale is critical to recovering value from returns.
args.title: Bellwether 2026 Returns: Combined Summary (Main + Subscriber Companion)
